facts.text: I am in the process of buying a new home.
I am trying to finalize my budget for a home purchase.
I got pre-approved for a $350,000 home loan from Wells Fargo.
I want to understand how much of the closing costs I can negotiate with the seller based on the inspection report.
I want to negotiate with the seller to cover some closing costs based on minor issues with the roof found in the inspection report.
I want to negotiate with the seller to cover some closing costs based on minor issues with the plumbing found in the inspection report.
I already agreed on a $2,000 credit towards the closing costs.
I am thinking of asking the seller to cover an additional 1% of the purchase price towards closing costs.
The additional 1% of the purchase price I am thinking of asking for would be $3,250.
I plan to ask the seller if they are willing to cover the additional $3,250 towards closing costs.
I want to estimate how much I will need to pay out of pocket for closing costs if the seller agrees to cover the additional $3,250.
I want to understand how much I will need to pay each month for my mortgage payment, property taxes, and insurance.

events.text: Request to estimate closing costs for a $325,000 house with Wells Fargo pre-approval for $350,000
Negotiation planning for seller to cover additional closing costs based on inspection report (roof and plumbing issues)
Agreed $2,000 credit towards closing costs and proposed additional 1% ($3,250) seller coverage
Plan to ask seller to cover additional $3,250 towards closing costs
Request to estimate monthly mortgage payment, property taxes, and insurance
